reason: Primary user-facing purpose is to act as a prompt-optimization utility inside the DSH composer: users can trigger model-based polishing of a draft prompt and review/insert the result. The README provides clear evidence of the optimization flow, streaming preview behavior, session/model integration, and optional custom LLM endpoint configuration, so the plugin is classified as a general utility for prompt text enhancement.

summaries.zh: 本插件为 DSH 输入框提供一键提示词优化功能，用户可在输入草稿后点击 ✨ 或按 Alt+O 即时生成更清晰、更结构化的提示词预览并进行替换或复制。
summaries.en: This plugin adds one-click prompt optimization to the DSH composer, allowing users to generate and preview a clearer, structured rewrite of a draft prompt and then insert or copy it.

capabilities: Optimizes user-entered prompt text through an LLM call and returns rewritten results for insertion into the composer
Streams optimization progress and output to a preview interface in real time
Supports both session-default model routing and a configurable OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint
Persists plugin configuration, including custom endpoint settings, in a local config file

reasons.code: README states the plugin rewrites a typed draft into a clearer prompt with one-click/Alt+O flow in the DSH composer and provides preview actions such as replace/copy/re-optimize.
README documents host APIs and SSE streaming flow (`optimize.stream`, `text/event-stream`, `delta`, `done`) that live-renders reasoning and token-by-token output.
README notes custom endpoint mode using an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` target, plus local config storage of API key and endpoint settings.
Repository description identifies this as a DSH Desktop/Electron plugin, indicating a UI-integrated desktop utility.
